item.title: Russia Looking to Escalate War, Not End it, Romanian Leader Says
item.description: President of Romania Nicușor Dan said that Europe was not prepared for the hybrid approach taken by Russia as the region deals with the military 'collateral damage' from the war in Ukraine, as well as targeted cyberattacks. Dan said that recent drone attacks against ships in Romania's territory of the Black Sea are not incidental and believes that Russia is looking to 'escalate' the war and provoke European countries. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: UBS Defeats Ex-Credit Suisse Managing Directors’ Back-Pay Claims
item.description: UBS Group AG prevailed against two former Credit Suisse Group AG managing directors who argued their deferred-compensation certificates shouldn’t have been written down when the banks merged in 2023.

item.title: Traders’ Cost of Hedging Against Big Treasuries Rally Is Soaring
item.description: The cost of options hedges against more gains in Treasuries surged to its highest level since March on Thursday, as investors sought the safety of US government bonds following a spike in oil prices and a deepening fiscal crisis in France.

item.title: RBC’s New Canada Stock Strategy Chief Sets TSX Target at 38,600
item.description: Royal Bank of Canada’s capital markets division named Sara Mahaffy as head of Canadian equity strategy, marking the first time in a decade it’s had a dedicated strategist covering the domestic stock market.
